cohort: The study included 688 women with singleton pregnancies, comprising 626 controls and 62 cases complicated by hypertensive disorders of pregnancy (HDP) and/or small-for-gestational-age (SGA) birth.
finding: PKR was significantly elevated in pregnancies with placental dysfunction (HDP only, HDP and SGA, SGA only) compared to controls, while SMII values were significantly lower only in pregnancies affected by SGA alone.
